description: This file implements a React component for the Explore page of a career navigator web application. It handles UI rendering, user interactions, data fetching for filters and search results, and manages different views such as cards, mind map, and multiverse exploration.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined by returning an empty string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range string from a role object into min and max in lakhs units.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role title from a role object, considering multiple possible field names.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role object matches the selected filters: industry, skills, salary range, and title query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React component for the Explore page, managing state, user interactions, data fetching, and rendering the UI.
